supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:39 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 recorded a network logon by omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01, address 10.30.10.23, with logon ID 0xd796b97. This matches the administrator and remote-administration source specified in the supplied inventory.

At 13:44:39 UTC, PowerShell PID 6440 ran as omar.haddad under the same logon ID, executing powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1. The account, script path, and business-hours timing match the supplied patching practice and calendar.

PowerShell PID 6440 connected to the explicit proxy on port 8080 using source port 61875. The corresponding network flow received approximately 38.8 MB, and the contemporaneous proxy record identifies a successful CONNECT to download.windowsupdate.com:443.
PowerShell PID 6440 launched wusa.exe to process C:\Windows\Temp\patches\windows11-kb5047001-x64.msu with /quiet /norestart, supporting the patch-deployment explanation.

PowerShell exited at 13:45:06 UTC, approximately 27 seconds after creation. This short-lived patching process is a plausible explanation for the reported brief PowerShell window, although its recorded start is approximately four minutes later than the reported approximate time.

known_telemetry_limitations: The process records identify the script path and command line but do not supply script contents, a script hash, or PowerShell script-block execution details (T024-00111, T024-00112).
The Windows Update proxy record describes a CONNECT tunnel, not inspected response content or package validation (T024-00113).
The process termination records do not establish that patch installation succeeded (T024-00122, T024-00123, T024-00124, T024-00125).
claims_not_established: The evidence does not directly establish that the PowerShell process at 13:44:39 UTC produced the exact window Maria reported around 13:40 UTC (T024-00111).
The script's integrity and successful installation of the named update are not established by the command-line and termination records alone (T024-00111, T024-00118, T024-00122).
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: GlobalProtect PanGPS.exe started as SYSTEM on WS-MLOPEZ-01, despite the supplied inventory stating there is no VPN. These records establish process execution, not an active VPN connection, and do not link it to the alerted PowerShell execution (T024-00039, T024-00040).

Separate ticket: taskhostw.exe on WS-MLOPEZ-01 recorded explicit use of svc-bkp credentials targeting PROXY-HD-01. The supplied inventory assigns this account to the backup agent on FILE-HD-01; authorization and authentication outcome require separate review (T024-00043).

Separate ticket: FILE-HD-01 initiated a connection to WS-MLOPEZ-01 on RPC endpoint-mapper port 135 at 13:57:32 UTC. Its purpose is not established; the connection alone does not prove remote administration or execution (T024-00170, T024-00172, T024-00173).

Separate ticket: GoogleDriveFS.exe started under maria.lopez at 14:11 UTC, inconsistent with the supplied cloud-storage approval list. These records do not establish a file upload or a relationship to the alerted PowerShell activity (T024-00278, T024-00280).
